AMPL.trigger: After the Q3 print resolves the margin question, re-enter only on a pullback that holds $14.97/$14.20.
AMPL.invalidation: A sustained break of the 50-day near $13.33, or a close below $13.33 on heavy volume, invalidates the long.
AMPL.horizon: Through the Q3 earnings gate; 3-6 months
AMPL.reevaluation: Re-upgrade only if Q3 revenue growth holds above 20%, net loss narrows, and gross margin stabilizes toward ~70%; stay flat or press a small short if losses widen, margins compress further, or price closes below $13.33 on heavy volume.
AMPL.ambiguity: The secondary token-short plan on a sustained $13.33 break has no concrete size or execution instruction.

CDNA.trigger: Short only a rejection candle on elevated volume of roughly 1.5M+ shares with a decisive upper wick in the $67.4-$69.8 resistance zone; a mere touch does not qualify.
CDNA.entry_convention: quarter-size tactical short for aggressive accounts only
CDNA.invalidation: Cover on a close back above $67.4 on volume; stop above $72.5; position must be flat or reduced to a runner before the confirmed November earnings date.
CDNA.horizon: Flat or reduced to a runner before the confirmed November earnings date
CDNA.reevaluation: Reassess after the November Q3 print or benign divestiture disclosure; a close above $67.4 on volume negates the short trigger.

HAE.trigger: Take a first half-size tranche at $116-$119 only if the retest of the $118-$119 breakout shelf holds on stable volume; add at $108-$110.
HAE.invalidation: A close below $110 invalidates the breakout structure and shifts bias toward a gap-fill near $101.
HAE.reevaluation: Revisit toward Buy if $118-$119 holds or price reaches $108-$110 together with a guidance raise quantifying NexSys revenue or a filing explaining the EPS dip; further margin erosion with elevated-price buybacks hardens avoidance.

HPE.trigger: Place a first buy tranche near $65.50; a second tranche belongs in the $61.50-$63.90 shelf only after the first fills and the uptrend holds; alternatively buy an above-average-volume close above $73.46.
HPE.entry_convention: staged pullback tranches plus a volume-confirmed breakout alternative
HPE.invalidation: A close below $61.50 means dip-buying support failed; reassess rather than average down.
HPE.reevaluation: A high-volume close above $73.46 cancels the cautious timing stance and restores momentum participation.

IOVA.trigger: Initiate the first tranche only on a pullback into $12.90-$13.70 that holds above $12.92; add on a decisive close above $15.30 on volume or after several sessions above $12.92 with no offering or adverse filing.
IOVA.entry_convention: staged long with reduced first tranche
IOVA.invalidation: Any announced equity offering voids the setup before entry; any daily close below $12.92 kills the idea outright.
IOVA.reevaluation: Check pending filings before fills where practicable; re-underwrite if the position fills but momentum stays flat; keep reduced size if Q3 10-Q cash is materially below ~$80M.
IOVA.ambiguity: The alternative second-tranche condition says several sessions above $12.92 without defining the session count.

MRNA.trigger: Re-evaluate on a daily close below $187, which confirms the correction, or a close above $227.46 on volume, which invalidates the bearish divergence and reopens a reduced-size long.
MRNA.entry_convention: stay flat; bearish exposure only through defined-risk OTM puts
MRNA.invalidation: A confirmed close above $227.46 on volume invalidates the bearish case.
MRNA.horizon: 1-3 months, keyed to the $187/$227.46 resolution levels and the next 10-Q
MRNA.reevaluation: Reassess on the next 10-Q, especially the unexplained ~$1B current-liability build, or if a verified catalyst for the August gap is identified.

P.trigger: After verifying the August 10-Q explains the ~$450M cash drawdown and ~$590M current-liability spike, take a starter tranche only on confirmed stabilization in the $128-$140 zone, or after a clean filing plus a failed breakdown.
P.entry_convention: verified-filing conditional starter tranche; no resting $140 limit order
P.invalidation: A close below ~$131 breaks the October structure and opens the $124-$128 retracement scenario; genuine cash-flow deterioration in the filing argues for structural avoidance.
P.reevaluation: Read the August 10-Q before sizing; upgrade toward Buy on a benign filing plus confirmed stabilization or failed breakdown, and downgrade to avoidance on genuine cash-flow deterioration.
P.ambiguity: Starter size is stated only as a 25%-33% range of intended size, not as a single fraction.

PD.trigger: Place quarter-size limit bids only in the $15.4-$15.8 support band.
PD.entry_convention: starter-size limit bids with a price-conditional earnings rule
PD.invalidation: Exit on a close below ~$15.1; if profitable going into earnings, trim half and let the rest ride; if flat-to-losing, exit before the print.
PD.horizon: Approximately 3 weeks into the earnings print; reassess post-print
PD.reevaluation: Revisit upgrading after earnings if revenue re-accelerates and guidance confirms the AI-ops narrative; evaluate the $13.7-$15.1 zone after a flat-print gap down rather than panic-selling.
PD.ambiguity: Sizing is described both as quarter-size (~$25k) and as no more than one-third of standard allocation (~$33k).

PENG.trigger: Take a first tranche at the $70-$72.61 breakout pivot only if it holds on falling volume; use the $60-$68 zone as the backstop if the shelf fails; take a small breakout tranche only on a confirmed hold above $80.47 with sustained volume.
PENG.invalidation: A stop discipline near $73.40 applies to any established position; failure of the $70-$72.61 shelf moves re-engagement to the $60-$68 backstop.
PENG.horizon: 3-6 months, contingent on the next earnings resolving the inventory question
PENG.reevaluation: The next earnings print decides whether the $498M inventory build converts to revenue; rebuild toward overweight if it does, or exit if inventory sits or compresses margins.
PENG.ambiguity: The stated $73.40 stop applies to any established position but is above the $70-$72.61 first-entry zone, so its application to a new pullback fill is unclear.

QMCO.trigger: Re-enter only after a completed financial close with no adverse disclosure plus tape stabilization: the $24.50-$25.10 shelf holding on declining volume or RSI tagging the low 30s near the $22.58 lower band.
QMCO.entry_convention: small starter only after event resolution and tape stabilization
QMCO.invalidation: Exit decisively on a close below $24.50; any adverse CFO-related disclosure, including restatement, control deficiency, delayed filing, or going-concern language, requires immediate full exit.
QMCO.horizon: Re-evaluate on CFO disclosure resolution and financial-close completion; staged re-entry window over the next 1-3 months if triggers are met
QMCO.reevaluation: Reassess after the CFO issue and financial close resolve, the recap terms and dilution cost are verified in the 10-Q, and the 10 EMA is reclaimed with the MACD histogram contracting.
